paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX haloscope search for axion dark matter over 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz). Excludes DFSZ couplings; the exclusion reaches DFSZ (g_agamma ~ 2e-16 GeV^-1 at these masses) and KSVZ. Precise per-mass coupling values are given only in Fig.4 which is not machine-readable in the text; the emitted points are approximate DFSZ-level values (~5.5e-16 GeV^-1 corresponds to roughly the plotted limit near ~5-6 x10^-16). Density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 for Maxwellian limit (0.63 for N-body).
